requirements.requirement: Correct registration class — ASU drug licence (e-AUSHADHI) OR FSSAI Ayurveda Aahara / Nutraceutical registration
requirements.source: Drugs & Cosmetics Act 1940 · FSSAI Ayurveda Aahara Regulations 2022

requirements.requirement: If classified as an ASU drug: product & manufacturing licence via e-AUSHADHI (State Licensing Authority)
If classified as Aahara/Nutraceutical: FSSAI registration / product approval with schedule compliance
Schedule T GMP (drugs) or FSSAI licensing hygiene & HACCP (food)
requirements.source: Schedule T, Drugs & Cosmetics Rules · FSSAI

requirements.requirement: Batch-level heavy-metal & microbial limit testing (NABL lab)
Label claims pass the claim firewall (no DMRA §3 / misleading claims)
requirements.source: Drugs & Magic Remedies Act 1954 · Ayush Suraksha 2023

requirements.requirement: Mandated language labeling and batch/lot markings for consignment
Evidence file supporting every claim on the label
Structure/function disclaimer on label — 'not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease' (21 CFR 101.93)
FDA 30-day DSHEA notification before interstate marketing (structure/function claims)
Dietary-supplement cGMP compliance (21 CFR 111)
Ingredients are 'old dietary ingredients' or NDI notification filed
Identity, purity, composition & strength documentation (21 CFR 111.75)
Supplement Facts panel and general labeling compliance (21 CFR 101)
Adequate substantiation for each claim (FTC standard)
Well-established/traditional herbal use with EU monograph coverage (≥15 yrs) for THMPD route
Traditional Herbal Medicinal Product registration in a Member State (or Novel Food route if not qualifying)
Any nutrition/health claim authorized via EFSA (Reg 1924/2006 art 10)
If supplement route: compliance with Food Supplements Directive 2002/46/EC
Heavy metals, pesticide & microbial limits for botanicals
Local-language labeling and safety-notice requirements
NHP product licence + site licence under Natural Health Products Regulations with monographic support
Foreign manufacturing-site annex audit / GMP equivalence evidence
Compendial identity, potency, purity & non-medicinal-ingredient QA
Adverse-reaction reporting procedure registered with Health Canada
Label claims reflect only licensed Terms of Market Authorization
Evidence dossier for each licensed health claim
